items.summary: Fix the WorkoutLibraryPage so that each muscle group section correctly displays its associated exercises. Diagnose and resolve the data mapping/filtering logic that causes exercise counts to show as zero for every muscle group. Ensure exercises are correctly associated with their muscle group and rendered inside the corresponding collapsible section.

Audit the useQueries.ts hooks and backend query for exercises to ensure the exercise data returned includes the correct muscle group field, and that the frontend filtering/grouping logic in WorkoutLibraryPage correctly matches exercises to their respective muscle group by the same key/ID used in both datasets.
